meta.verdictRule: scripts/derivation_rules_backtest.mjs verdictOf (PWC100), floor 10 held-out rows; nothing is fitted, so the whole stated set is the fair test when the held-out slice is under the floor (precedent: gu.rank.precursor)

A.claim: the potion is made with a same-Sequence characteristic of its pathway in the main slot (formula states it, or a scene or price shows it used or accepted as the main)
A.baseline: majority class of the training split; a tie goes to natural-only (the reading with no characteristic law)

B.claim: number of main-slot entries on the formula sheet
B.rulePredicts: the number of main slots in derivedSpec (1 for Sequence 9 to 1)
B.baseline: modal count in the training split

C.claim: at least one supplementary item is listed
C.note: every formula lists some, so this axis cannot separate the rule from anything; reported for completeness
